title: WindTech Webinar
summary: WindTech was a felicitous event which was organized by IEEE PES UoP Student Chapter. This has been a useful webinar which was conducted by Eng. Sudath Chandana on the 14th of July 2022 via zoom platform. This event has opened up everyone’s minds about the idea of wind power and the future of sustainable energy.
